review.notes: Full review of README.md and Suggested.lean at Mathlib 6b7abb3c / Tau Ceti a91d3aa. Gate: every check passed; depcheck 0 problems, no UPWARD/CYCLE; lake env lean on a probe copy with #check lines: three sorry warnings only, elaborated types agree with the README; one-tactic padding probe closes nothing. Seeded sample (the computability-vs-invariance dichotomy) verified against SW06, MOT09, MO10 (279 pp), LOT10, MOS06, MOST06 and the OSS book (authors' copy, author page); Nemethi 0709.0841 (3.1.4, 3.1.11, 3.2.1-3.2.6, 3.3.2, 3.4.1-3.4.3, 4.2.4), Zemke 2111.14962 (Thm 1.1, 2.3, eq 2.3), MOST Thm 6.1, OSS 0912.0830 (Def 1.1-1.2, Thm 1.3, Thm 10.4), book Thm 5.3.1/Def 6.1.5/Rem 4.6.10/(8.2)/Thm 11.6.1 all checked at their locators. All 40 cited Tau Ceti names and 10 Mathlib files exist at the pins; HeegaardFloer, GeometricTopology, MorseTheory citations resolve on main with consistent supply direction; no other owner among the 434 open pull requests. 13-row adversarial table with computed values. Blocking: R01 (P2) the roadmap's end theorem, invariance of GH- under grid moves, is statable at the pin (exactly the hypothesis of GridDiagram.IsKnot.tau_eq_of_linearEquiv) but Suggested.lean states only its tau corollary; the repair statement elaborates. P3: torus-knot chirality sign in the acceptance criteria, MOST section-number locator, tau_stabilizeX attribution and incomplete remaining-input list, a negative control that does not separate (hP unused by Nemethi's route), the epsilon-orbit sentence omitting the lattice translation, process language and missing Needs/Checks for the new Lane L items. One source misprint recorded (Nemethi Prop 3.3.4).
